description: This file defines a handler for creating and migrating teams within an organization, including permission checks, slug validation, team creation, and team migration logic with associated utilities.

classes.name: NotAuthorizedError
classes.description: Error class for unauthorized access, extends TRPCError with FORBIDDEN code.

classes.name: InvalidMetadataError
classes.description: Error class for invalid organization metadata, extends TRPCError with BAD_REQUEST code.

classes.name: NoOrganizationError
classes.description: Error class for missing organization, extends TRPCError with BAD_REQUEST code.

classes.name: NoOrganizationSlugError
classes.description: Error class for missing organization slug, extends TRPCError with BAD_REQUEST code.

methods.name: moveTeam
methods.description: Handles moving a team to a new organization, updating slug and parent, moving credits, inviting existing members, and adding redirects.

methods.name: tryToCancelSubscription
methods.description: Attempts to cancel a Stripe subscription by ID, logs errors if any.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Extracts subscription ID from team metadata if present.

methods.name: addTeamRedirect
methods.description: Creates or updates a redirect from an old team slug to a new one within an organization.
